scientific_integrity: Ordinary proof with finite-field exhaustive computational corroboration. No independent audit, formal proof certificate, or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The component theorem is for reduced zero-product loci only; the nonreduced multiplication scheme is not classified.
The star incidence algebra is fixed; arbitrary finite posets, general quivers, and two-sided annihilation are outside scope.
Historical publication priority remains provisional; one plausible triangular-algebra source was accessible only at abstract level.
Finite verification is supplementary and independent mathematical audit was not performed.
title: Zero-product loci of star incidence algebras: components and finite-field enumeration
